ننتمي (form VIII)
# نَنْتَمِي (nantamī) /nan.ta.miː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَمَى (intamā)
# نَنْتَمِيَ (nantamiya) /nan.ta.mi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَمَى (intamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
